entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Alex at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Okay, I can certainly help with that. Could I get your order number to pull up your account?
It's VF-886-75309. It's for a jersey.
Got it. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the Men's Aero Jersey, delivered on January 1st. To make sure I'm helping correctly, what specifically is the issue with the item?
It's the wrong size. I ordered a medium and it's way too tight.
I understand. So to clarify, it's a preference issue with the fit, not a technical fault or defect with the jersey itself, correct?
I guess. Unless you consider making sizes that don't fit people a defect.

I see. Well, the good news is you are well within our 90-day return policy for apparel. We can definitely get this sorted out for you. Would you prefer an exchange for a different size, or a full refund?
Fine. An exchange, I guess. For a large.

Excellent choice. I've just initiated that exchange in our system. I'm sending you an email right now with a prepaid return label. Just pack up the original jersey, attach the label, and drop it off. As soon as the tracking updates, we'll ship out the size large to you.
Whatever. As long as it actually happens.
It will. The email with the label has just been sent. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright then. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and we'll have your new gear out to you shortly. Have a great day.
